title: The Wolf Queen Awakened
description: Potema the Wolf Queen has escaped her binding and is gathering power in her catacombs beneath Solitude. Falk Firebeard sends the player to Styrr for the key, then into Potema's Catacombs to defeat her and retrieve her remains for sanctification.

base_facts: I am the steward of the Blue Palace in Solitude.
Potema the Wolf Queen has escaped her binding ritual and must be stopped.
I sent a letter warning of the threat and requesting the adventurer's return.
Styrr the priest of Arkay can provide guidance and the key to Potema's Catacombs.

MS06_STAGE_50: I have sent the adventurer to speak with Styrr about how to stop Potema.
MS06_COMPLETE: Potema has been defeated and her remains sanctified. I spoke on behalf of the jarl to express our gratitude and rewarded the adventurer with gold and the Shield of Solitude.
The threat of the Wolf Queen's full resurrection has been ended for Solitude and Haafingar.
The Shield of Solitude carries a unique Resist Magic enchantment not found elsewhere, a worthy gift for one who saved the city.
A courier may deliver a follow-up letter concerning further Wolf Queen business if circumstances permit.

base_facts: I am a priest of Arkay at Solitude's Hall of the Dead.
Potema was a formidable necromancer and former Queen of Solitude who raised armies of the dead.
Potema's remains must be sanctified to prevent her full resurrection.
I hold the key to Potema's Catacombs beneath the Temple of the Divines.

MS06_STAGE_50: I gave the adventurer the key to Potema's Catacombs and the spell Turn Undead.
MS06_STAGE_150: I have received Potema's remains and will bless them to prevent her return.
MS06_COMPLETE: I have blessed Potema's remains to ensure the Wolf Queen can never return in corporeal form.
The adventurer who retrieved Potema's skull has earned my gratitude and that of Arkay's faithful.
By returning Potema's remains for sanctification, the adventurer has done a great service to the people of Haafingar.

beats.comment: Player sent to speak with Styrr about Potema and receive the catacombs key.
Player enters Potema's Catacombs to confront and defeat Potema.
Player retrieves Potema's skull from the throne in the sanctum.
Player returns Potema's remains to Styrr for blessing and must report to Falk.
Quest complete. Falk rewards the player with gold and the Shield of Solitude.
